miso-queue.how: Ran pull_queues.py --state WI on 2026-11-17 and read the whole MISO queue file through its open address, then checked every Wisconsin request that needs an answer against GEM, the state utility commission dockets and news.
miso-queue.found: 44 requests need an answer. Four gas requests match no GEM plant and are added: J4164 in Dane County, J4165 in Kenosha County, J4115 in Fond du Lac County and J4116 in Walworth County. J3156 is the Riverside upgrade. Thirteen are tied to GEM plants, three are in Iowa and the rest hide their fuel.

psc-erf-docket.how: Read the docket harvest in batches/us-wi/harvest/psc_dockets.json and opened each docket that matched no GEM plant in the commission filing system, by docket number.
psc-erf-docket.found: None of the 22 unmatched dockets is new gas generation: 3270-CE-128 to 131 are solar, 5-BS-256 and 5-CE-160 are wind, 5-BS-286, 300 and 301 are gas territory agreements, 5-CE-150 and 5-CE-156 are Columbia ash and carbon storage, 6220-CE-104 and 6630-CE-313 are electrical equipment, and the TE and AE dockets are tariffs and affiliate agreements. 6680-TE-116 is a large load customer in northern Dane County with no generators found. Docket 2345-CE-100 for Custer engines was withdrawn in January 2022 and the Custer turbine is 24.5 MW.

psc-erf-document.how: Opened each commission document cited by the harvest and by the plan reading through the document viewer, saving the texts under work/sweep_us-wi.
psc-erf-document.found: Document 617707 ties MISO J4014 and J4249 to the Union Depot plant. Documents 595734 and 595738 are the draft Strategic Energy Assessment. Document 572462 is the South Oak Creek record.

psc-case-pages.how: Read the commission case pages for Red Oak Ridge, Foundry Ridge, South Oak Creek, Paris and Fox North by name.
psc-case-pages.found: Every case page describes a plant already in GEM. Red Oak Ridge says up to 1,186 MW in the Town of Paris, which is handled on its own plant record.

dnr-warp.how: Searched the state air permit system by facility name for every GEM plant and every lead with the scope harvester, and opened the permit documents for Fitchburg, Elk Mound, Riverside, the CLOP Madison and Degas Beaver Dam data centers and Microsoft Mount Pleasant.
dnr-warp.found: Fitchburg and Elk Mound permits confirm two operating plants GEM lacks. The Riverside permit confirms the 2004 block and its upgrade. The data center permits give 18.5 MW at CLOP Madison, about 12 MW at Degas, and 722.5 MW at Mount Pleasant, which its own plant record handles.

dnr-notices.how: Read the state air permit public notice list in the harvest and matched each power plant or engine notice to GEM.
dnr-notices.found: Every power plant notice is for a plant in GEM or for a data center already answered under data_centers.

dnr-eia-pages.how: Read the state environmental analysis page for Port Washington and the topic list for other power and data center projects.
dnr-eia-pages.found: Port Washington covers the Vantage and Oracle campus, which is in GEM. No other power project is listed.

epa-echo.how: Queried the federal enforcement database for the 45 active Wisconsin air facilities with industry code 4911 and matched each to GEM and the federal generator file.
epa-echo.found: Elk Mound is the only plant at or above 50 MW that GEM lacks, and it is added. The municipal diesel plants at Arcadia, Cashton, Elroy, Fennimore, La Farge and New Lisbon are each under 20 MW. Kaukauna's turbine is 18 MW. Manitowoc, Bay Front and Rothschild burn coal, coke or wood. The rest are in GEM, nuclear or hydro.

epa-rblc.how: Posted keyword searches for turbine and for engine with state WI to the clearinghouse service and read all 46 results.
epa-rblc.found: Every power plant permit is for a plant in GEM except Sheepskin (41.7 MW, retired 2020, below the threshold) and the Turtle, Badger Generating and Southern Energy permits of 1999 and 2000, which have no generator in the federal file and were never built. The 2025 and 2026 entries are the Paris engines, the Neenah upgrade and a paper mill.

Searches for Sugar Creek Energy and Fitzgerald Energy found no company.
